summary: Steel fire tower with an octagonal cupola on Onaping Lake Road, Sudbury District; now used as a communications tower.

facts.design: Heavy-gauge steel tower with an octagonal cupola

events.note: Shown on the Department of Lands and Forests Tower Detection System Map (1963); a map record, not a register

evidence.supports: location on Onaping Lake Road, Unorganized North Sudbury, Sudbury District

evidence.quote: Heavy gauge steel; octagonal cupola; towerman’s quarters located at Onaping Lake, McDonald Bay; currently used as a communications tower.

evidence.supports: shown on 1963 Department of Lands and Forests tower map
evidence.quote: Appears on Department of Lands and Forests Tower Detection System Map (1963).
Appears on Sudbury topographic map 41-I, 3rd ed., 1997.

notes_for_editor: One source only (firelookout.ca). Two searches found no other page on this tower. No build year, builder, staffing, fire or access record was found, so none is stated. The record's coordinates (-81.583304) differ from the source's (-81.58574) by roughly 180 m; possibly a typo, not corrected here. The source lists an octagonal cupola in the design but does not say whether it is still there. The record's 'standing' status is consistent with the source's current communications use. The Ontario geoHub tower dataset in source_pages gave no readable text.
